name: What information do you need to start AEO for my dental clinic?

mainEntity.name: What information do you need to start AEO for my dental clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: To begin AEO for your dental clinic, we typically require access to your current website analytics, a list of services offered, your target patient demographics, and any specific areas of expertise or unique selling propositions of your practice. Understanding your existing content, local competition, and business goals is also essential. This foundational information allows us to conduct thorough keyword research, identify common patient questions, and develop a tailored content strategy that aligns with your practice's objectives and local market.
acceptedAnswer.description: To start AEO, we need your website analytics, services, target demographics, unique selling points, existing content, and business goals to develop a tailored strategy.
